title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber I Cap. 7 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber I Cap. 7 De sensu & interpretatione sacrae Scripturae COMPLETE (PHYS 245–mid-276 before Cap. 8).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book I Chapter 7 On Sacred Scripture's sense and interpretation, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (PHYS 245–mid-276): sense as Scripture's letter agreeing with the Spirit's intent; against enthusiasm and multiplex sense in one utterance; interpretation defined; five hermeneutic norms; interpreter's regeneration and languages; Hebrew/Greek authentic texts; threefold medium; didactic vs judicial interpretation; against papal sole interpreter; six illegitimate measures of sense; public and private interpretive power. Cap. 8 On Scripture's efficacy begins mid PHYS 276; Cap. 6 complete; the rest of the Syntagma remains.
era_note: Crocius wrote in the early seventeenth century as Reformed professor at the illustrious school of Bremen. This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1636 Villerian folio is Public Domain Mark 1.0. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.
first_english_note: No complete public-domain English of this 1636 Latin Syntagma was locked as reading text. This is a new rendering from locked Latin for Liber I Cap. 7 densify complete.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1636 Bremen Latin of Liber I Cap. 7 densify COMPLETE, reconstructed from SLUB Dresden page images (PHYS 245–mid-276 before CAPUT OCTAVUM). Same-page OCR (tesseract lat + Vision) used as check. No modern English was copied. Cap. 8 (CAPUT OCTAVUM / De sacrae Scripturae efficacia) begins mid PHYS 276. No Internet Archive copy was located.
